tools.name: list_stocks
tools.description: Tokenized stocks listed on The River, with ticker, token symbol, issuer, chain and trade link. Filter by chain and/or a search query (ticker, symbol or name).

tools.name: trade_link
tools.description: A pre-filled River trade link. A buy by ticker with usd (no address or chain) returns a best-price link that opens the cheapest issuer for the user. Give exactly one of usd (buy only, settlement stablecoin, up to 6 decimals) or qty (tokens, up to 18 decimals). The user reviews this on The River and

tools.name: strategy_link
tools.description: A pre-filled River strategy card link (Base, ST0x stocks). tools.name: wallet_holdings
tools.description: Any wallet's stock-token and cash balances on every chain The River serves (public onchain data), plus its read-only River profile link.

tools.name: fair_value
tools.description: Last US market price and market status of listed stocks (what the tokens track). Up to 12 tickers.
